title: Refusal to Transform
paragraphs: Well then, having decided to hunt monsters for money, I immediately sprang into action. Along the way, I was lucky enough to spot some bandits!
“Gyaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
“W-what? An enemy attack!? Are you adventurers from somewhere!? A government expedition or a vigilante group!?”
“Hand over anything of value! Hahahahaha!”
“You… you’ve got some nerve trying to rob us thieves! You bastards! Don’t let him go back alive!”
“It’s Aiming Lancer X!”
The skills I unleashed pierced the bandits’ bodies and legs. Of course, I held back just enough so they wouldn’t die. Hahaha! Bandits are a resource, after all!
“‘Gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!’”
While I was at it, I discovered the thieves’ hideout, so I took it down and confiscated everything. As for the thieves themselves… well, that was a “Release” move that Father taught me.
Well then… I was lucky enough to make some quick cash. For now, I’m going to drop by and say hi to my favorite Filolial producer!
And so, skipping along as I went, I headed to the Filolial breeder’s place and got to know them better while engaging in our usual small talk. You know how it goes—I’ll skip the details.
“So? What’s your budget, and what kind of Filolial do you want?”
“I’ve already decided!”
“Huh? Oh well… Which egg are you going with?”

I checked the Filolial eggs in the shed the producer showed me to—the ones I’d naturally chosen during the loop: Yuki-chan, Kou, and Sakura-chan’s eggs… but Yuki-chan and Sakura-chan aren’t here! Why aren’t they here!?

Think back carefully! I remember that in the first world, Yuki-chan became a racing bird, and after peace was restored, she came to the village that Father had settled. When we reunited, it felt so nostalgic. In other words, that means Yuki-chan has already been shipped out.
As for why Sakura-chan isn’t here… Come to think of it, Sakura-chan becomes Filo-tan. So, since Filo-tan is here now, Sakura-chan isn’t around, is she?

Oh my… If I choose Filo-tan, I can’t meet Sakura-chan, and if I choose Sakura-chan, I can’t meet Filo-tan. Fate is truly cruel. Is there no way to create a world where Filo-tan and Sakura-chan can coexist? I feel like Father mentioned something like that too!
“For now… give me this egg!”
And so, luckily, I managed to snag Kou, who was still left unsold!
“You really are a strange one, aren’t you?”

This Filolial producer says that every time we meet. Well, whatever will be, will be! I’m in a great mood today! After all, I managed to get at least Kou. Yuki-chan, I’m looking forward to seeing you again.
“Well, I’ll be back!”
“Ah, show me how much he’s grown.”
So, I said goodbye to the Filolial producer… and this time, I teleported to Melromarc. I walked through the town below the castle, skipping along the way. It’s the same old townscape as always.
My destination is the Monster Merchant’s place! So, I made my way to the Monster Merchant’s tent.
“Welcome. Hello.”
The Monster Merchant greets me, rubbing his hands together. He’s a handy guy—if you pay him enough, he’ll even set you up with a sister-in-law through Father.
“You’re a first-time customer, aren’t you? If I’m not mistaken, you’re… the Spear Hero, correct? Is that right?”
“That’s right!”
“We’ve heard the rumors as well. What brings you to our shop? Are you looking for the slave the Shield Hero brought with him?”

I suppose he’s deducing this from the fact that Father bought Big Sister from The Slave Trader. He must have gathered information—perhaps about the duel at the castle—which is why he mentioned it. However, my purpose is different.
“If the Spear Hero is here, we’ll do our very best to provide a slave that suits your tastes. What kind of slave do you prefer?”
“Filo-chan.”

Oops, Filo-chan’s already here. I just blurted that out on autopilot. Besides, Filo-chan isn’t a slave in the first place! ……Oh, come to think of it, this is usually the time of year when Filo-tan would be in a cage here, running wild. Just one slight difference in the path leads to changes like this, doesn’t it?
“Huh? Uh, um… Do you mean Filo-Real? Y-yes.”
“There’s no need to worry about it.”
“Ah, I see. Yes. So, what brings you to our shop today?”

Now, as for Kuro-chan… I know he’s already gone by this time of year. If my memory serves me correctly, he’s supposedly working at some ranch under the name Black Thunder. They say he’s growing up to be a mischievous young Filolial. That was a heartwarming sight in its own way. Kuro-chan was the kind of guy who could become friends with anyone he met, no matter where he went.

Now then… I need to introduce a Filolial with just the right temperament to help my current Father appreciate how wonderful the Filolials are. Thinking back to Father from the first world, Midori or Yuki-chan would be good choices, but Yuki-chan is missing, after all. It brings to mind the scene of Kou getting lectured by Father, but I’m sure it’ll be just fine!
“I’d like to buy a Filolial’s egg!”

“Right, right. You mean a monster, not a slave? True, the Spear Hero is surrounded by beautiful women, so perhaps he doesn’t need one at this point. Yes. But if you ever want a slave who’ll do anything you say, please do come to us…”
“I’d much rather have Lady Filolial than some slave pig.”

This monster merchant has started a strange new business, hasn’t he? Buying and selling pigs… Is he planning to switch careers to become a pig rancher and butcher or something? Upon hearing my words, the monster merchant is having his burly henchmen prepare Lady Filolial’s eggs. Just checking to be sure.
I see some familiar faces. Of course, they’re the ones I’ve met in previous loops. Still, as expected, there’s no egg from Kuro-chan.
“Then I’ll take this one, this one, and this Filolial egg from the egg lottery, please.”
As long as I don’t hatch them, it’s no problem to buy them within my budget.
“Well, as for the monster lottery… we make sure you can’t tell if they’re Filolial or not. Yes.”
“Hahaha, you can’t fool my eyes.”

I’ll grab Luna-chan while I’m at it. Judging by the order, it might be best to hatch Luna-chan next—she’s a fellow egg lottery companion just like Filo-tan. Luna-chan is such a well-behaved girl, so Father might take a liking to her.
“Uh… I didn’t expect you to have such a keen eye. Yes. Is there some secret to it?”
“You can tell just by looking at it and sniffing it!”
“…O-okay, I understand. Yes. It seems you have a very keen eye. Yes.”

The monster merchant started wiping the sweat from his brow. Is it hot in here? I handed the money pouch to the monster merchant and carefully counted the bags containing the eggs before accepting them.
"Thank you very much. What should we do about registering the monster emblems and the incubator?"
“I’m not going to hatch them just yet, but I’d like to buy an incubator.”
“Yes.”

And so, I got the incubator and the Filolials. Now… it’s about time I went to pick up Father. That should be around the time Filo-chan takes on her angelic form. It’s time to show off my brilliant planning by making sure her clothes are all set! To that end, I’ll look for a shop in Zeltoble that sells equipment for turning Magical Power into thread.
So, after returning to Zeltoble, I placed Lady Filolial’s egg in my inn room, bought the supplies needed to make Filo-tan’s clothes, and then went to pick up Father and the others.
“Hey there, Father! I’ve come to pick you up!”
“Hmm… Motoyasu, is it?”
It was snack time—the moment I’d predicted when Filo-tan would take on her angelic form. I made my way to where Father was camping and resting in the woods near Zeltoble.
“W-well, you really did come… How did you find me?”
“Why, through footprints, scent, and a sense of presence, of course. No matter where you and the others go, this Motoyasu will be right there.”
“That’s quite the stalker confession.”
It seems Father is offering me some words of praise. I’m getting a little embarrassed with all this praise.
“Just as Naofumi-sama says, it seems you’d chase us to the ends of hell.”
“You won’t get anything out of praising me like that.”
“I’m not praising you. Seriously… Do I need a portal to escape, too?”
“Even then, I don’t think I could get away.”
“…Ah. It doesn’t look like I’ll be able to escape until I finish this wave and head back.”

Big Sister has fallen silent, looking rather pensive. She’s probably feeling lonely now that she’s heard Father is leaving. But don’t worry. If my memory serves me correctly, Father stayed behind in this world.
“So, Father, how’s it going?”

“The battles up until the day before yesterday seem like a joke compared to how easily we’re racking up EXP now. Needless to say, Filo is taking down enemies with ease, and so is Raphtalia—I’m the only one holding us back.”
“Quest!”
Philo-tan is standing tall. That’s Filo-chan for you! She really came through for Father!
“The monsters feel way too weak, though… I wonder why. I’m starting to get this uneasy feeling—is this really okay?”

“Based on my experience, this kind of power-leveling lets you gain raw strength, but you don’t gain the experience that goes with it. You’ll end up showing your weaknesses somewhere. So you’ve got to be really careful.”
“Yes. How can we fix this?”
“Simply training with someone stronger than us… or something like that.”
Father is staring at me. It’s kind of embarrassing. However, after his expression turned slightly mocking—as if to say, “That’s not going to happen”—he said:
“Other than that… maybe just Filo. If Raphtalia’s Older Sister is strong, it might be a good idea to ask her to train you.”
“Yeah… Older Sister Sadeena might be willing to teach me.”
That’s true. Her Older Sister has amazing skills, after all. That said, if you want to learn the techniques, I know just the person.
“If you’re looking for training, there’s someone who’d be perfect.”

I remember her. She’s the old woman who’s the master of Big Sister and Éclair. From what I’ve heard, she was bedridden with illness when Father stopped by during one of his trading trips and helped her. Since he helped her occasionally even in the previous loop, he knows where she is, so I’m sure he can introduce us.
“Well, it does seem like she has the foundation to become strong enough, but—Motoyasu—we can’t start until you prove that your story is true.”

Father muttered this as he looked at Filo-tan, who was sitting on the ground using him as a shield. That’s right. That’s where we’ll start, I suppose. Personally, I’d love to see Filo-chan in her angel form as soon as possible.
“Filo-chan, it’s about time. I’d love to catch a glimpse of that adorable angel form, bathed in that dazzling halo. If you do that, I guarantee even Father will be head over heels for your charm.”
The world is filled with the light of Filo-chan and Filolial. It’s all built by the angel sent by God—Father.
“Hm?”
“I don’t want to!”
Oh, Filo-chan spoke to me! What a crystal-clear voice—it’s music to my ears.
Father and Big Sister are looking at Filo-chan with half-closed eyes. What’s the matter? They seem a bit exasperated, if I’m not mistaken.
“The guy with the spear is gross. That’s why, Filo, I don’t want to change my form!”
“What?! That’s outrageous! Please, I’d love to see you in your angelic form!”
“No way!”

To think I won’t be able to behold Filo-chan’s magnificent true form… though her current form is wonderful as well. It’s a shame I can’t see her angelic form, but I don’t want to force Filo-tan into showing it. After all, I want Filo-tan to transform freely, of her own volition.
“I hate that look in your eyes! Filo, you’re gross!”
“Filo-tan!”
“Nooo!”
Just as I was about to pounce, Filo-tan ran away.
“How should I put this…”
“Filo’s hungry. Master—more food!”
“Father, what’s the matter?”

For some reason, Father has put his hand to his forehead and is looking down. I wonder what’s going to happen to Filo-tan’s meal? I could make it myself, but it wouldn’t taste as good as Father’s cooking.
“How should I put this… Can you even talk while looking like that?”
“Huh? Yeah.”
Of course. The organ that produces Filolial-sama’s adorable voice… the vocal cords are all-purpose, you know.
“So? Can you transform?”
“I can! Then I can sleep in the same room as Master and kick out that guy with the spear, right? Master said that when he was sleeping with Filo.”
“Damn… so she was listening.”
It seems Father and the others were talking to Filo while I wasn’t around. It must have been some kind of meeting.
“Look, Filo, try not to provoke the Spear Hero quite so much…”
“I’ll be by your side wherever you go. Even if there’s a Wall, it’s as good as nonexistent in my presence.”
“Eek! That gives me the creeps!?”
Ah, Filo-tan. Please don’t say such tantalizing things. My rationality is about to fly right out the window.
“Anyway, Motoyasu, you… stay a little ways back, behind that tree. I’m going to do some investigating.”
“What exactly are you going to do?”
“Just go already!”
Ugh… Well, if it’s Father’s order, I suppose I have no choice. I hid behind the tree, fired a beam from my Zweite Feuerauge to make a small hole in the trunk, and peered through it.
